hosting: romUrl values are same-repo relative paths (relative to classic/gb/index.html); remote URLs can be dropped in later with no code changes.

games.title: LIBBET AND THE MAGIC FLOOR
games.desc: Puzzle-platformer by Damian Yerrick (pinobatch). Libbet rolls under a floor of carpet tiles and pops up to find her way through the dungeon — built with the same engine tech as his NES hits.

games.title: SNAKE
games.desc: Snake for the Game Boy and Game Boy Color by Christian Reinbacher (reini1305), built with GBDK. Eat, grow, and try not to bite yourself across timed rounds.
A working port of the 2048 tile-sliding puzzle for the classic Game Boy by Wyatt Ferguson. Slide with the D-pad; SELECT resets the board.

games.title: FLAPPYBOY
games.desc: Flappy Bird for the Game Boy by Felipe Alfonso (bitnenfer), written in C with GBDK. Tap through the pipes on real DMG hardware graphics.

games.title: 240P TEST SUITE (GB)
games.desc: Artemio's 240p Test Suite, Game Boy port by pinobatch (same project as the NES 240pee). Pro-grade CRT/upscaler test patterns in your pocket.
